title: Insulation and Window Rebates in Riverside 2026: RPU Weatherization Rebates | HomePowerRebate
desc: Riverside Public Utilities pays 10 to 20 cents per square foot for attic insulation, 15 cents for walls and $1 per square foot for ENERGY STAR windows. Rules and steps.
h1: Insulation and Window Rebates in Riverside
badge: 10 to 20 cents per sq ft, $1 per sq ft windows
lead: Riverside Public Utilities (RPU) pays by the square foot for attic and wall insulation and $1 per square foot for ENERGY STAR windows, with smaller amounts for fans, ducts and cool roofs. The rates are modest, so this page shows what the numbers add up to on a real house.
cards_intro: These figures come from RPU's weatherization rebate page, which we read on October 2, 2026. Only residential RPU electric customers qualify, and funding is limited. Rebates are calculated for the nearest R-value.

cards.title: Attic insulation
cards.note: 10 cents at R-19, 15 or 20 cents at R-30 or R-38 and above.

cards.title: ENERGY STAR windows and glass doors
cards.note: Window film (NFRC certified) and solar window screens (SHGC of 0.40 or less) also earn $1 per sq ft.

cards.title: Fans, ducts and roofs
cards.note: Whole house fan $100, solar attic fan $100 (two), electric attic vent fan $50 (two), duct replacement up to $150, cool roof $0.10 per sq ft.

after_cards:
What it adds up to

Insulating 1,500 square feet of attic to R-38 earns up to 1,500 x $0.20 = $300. Replacing 200 square feet of windows with ENERGY STAR units earns 200 x $1 = $200. A whole house fan adds $100. These are small against the cost of the work, so treat them as a bonus on projects you would do anyway for comfort.
sections: RPU pays 10 cents per square foot for R-19 attic insulation, and 15 or 20 cents for R-30 or R-38 and above. Going from R-19 to R-38 doubles the rebate per square foot, and it also does far more for comfort. Ask your contractor for the existing R-value and the finished one in writing, since the rebate is calculated for the nearest R-value, and ask which of R-30 or R-38 your attic can take.
Windows and shading are a hot-summer upgrade

RPU pays $1 per square foot for ENERGY STAR windows and glass doors, window film and solar window screens. In a climate where the average January low over 2015 to 2024 was only 6.8°C but summers run long and hot, keeping sun out matters more than keeping heat in. A solar screen is far cheaper per square foot than a new window and earns the same $1. Check that film is NFRC certified and screens have a solar heat gain coefficient of 0.40 or less.

RPU pays up to $150 to replace an entire duct system with insulated ducts of at least R-6. Ducts in a hot attic can lose a large share of the cooling you pay for, and replacing a heat pump without fixing them wastes part of the new unit's benefit. RPU also lists duct sealing with a blower door test, for older existing systems only. Ask your contractor to test the ducts first.

RPU's rates here are lower than the stand-alone attic rebate of LADWP at $0.50 to $0.75 per square foot (Los Angeles) but it covers windows, ducts and fans in one program. Apply by mail or email to RPURebates@riversideca.gov within 90 days of purchase, with proof of purchase and the supporting documents. See the heat pump rebate on Riverside heat pump rebates if you plan to replace the system as well.

The federal 25C and 25D tax credits ended after December 31, 2025. We found no comparable program from SCE for nearby cities. RPU's SHARE and Energy Savings Assistance options can cover free upgrades for income-qualified households, so check them before you spend.
claim_heading: How to claim an RPU weatherization rebate
claim_steps: Confirm that Riverside Public Utilities is your electric utility.
Measure the existing attic R-value and decide the target (R-19, R-30 or R-38).
Have the work done, and keep the invoice with the square footage and R-value.
For windows, film or screens, keep the labels showing ENERGY STAR, NFRC or SHGC.
Complete RPU's application and send it with the receipts within 90 days of purchase.
RPU verifies and pays the rebate.
faq: How much does RPU pay for attic insulation?
10 cents per square foot at R-19 and 15 or 20 cents at R-30 or R-38 and above.
Yes, 15 cents per square foot for R-13 or higher.
How much is the window rebate?
$1 per square foot for ENERGY STAR windows and glass doors, window film and solar window screens.
How long do I have to apply?
Within 90 days of the purchase date.
Is there a rebate for ducts?
Yes, up to $150 to replace the entire duct system with insulated ducts of at least R-6.
